## LoggingHelper.\_formatErrorObj() method

Format an error object to a JSON string.

**Signature:**

```typescript
_formatErrorObj(pureError: Error | unknown): string;
```

pureError

</td></tr>
</tbody></table>

**Returns:**

string

JSON string representation of the error.

## Example


```typescript
const logger = new LoggingHelper();
const formatted = logger._formatErrorObj(new Error("Test"));
// => '{\n  "message": "Test",\n  "stack": "...",\n  "name": "Error"\n}'
```
